dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Thanks for bringing me here. It's so peaceful — the perfect place to meditate.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Though there's nothing I really need to think about right now... I might end up nodding off.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: But don't worry, I'll just have to think of something worth thinking about instead...

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: This domain is constantly changing, and the danger constantly evolving.. So I have something for you.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: This is what we call the "three warnings." Be wary of beasts prowling around, scammers looking for their next victim, and strange people who appear out of nowhere.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: You'd best learn that by heart — it might come in handy someday.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: The records here are fascinating, like the clouds in the sky that lie beyond reach. They contain so much information.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: It would take a real genius to turn all of this into a woven scroll.

dialogues.speaker: Ororon
dialogues.text: Please don't look at me so... expectantly. I... don't think that's something I could manage myself. Sorry about that.
